Afternoon lounge crew,
Handover notes, at dusk: a short note from our desk

Good evening, team. Please keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk watchlist current and make sure each passenger receives clear guidance before departure. The senior coordinator is holding final service calls, so route any exception quickly and keep the tone brisk, calm, and exact. If a case needs extra handling, record the facts plainly and pass the file without delay.

For Caldreth, <<FACT F019>> and the follow-up notes should stay attached to the same record. <<FACT F025>> Keep the quarantine paperwork aligned with the manifest, and confirm that any kennel assignment is reflected in the lounge log before handover. For Port Isolde, <<FACT F003>> and note the name of the passenger coordinator in the service file, since that desk continues to rely on clean internal routing. Where travelers are moving with pets, remind them that crate checks, health papers, and escort steps must be in order before they reach the gate.

Please keep the counters tidy, the handoffs concise, and the updates factual. If Mei Hernandez or Omar Romano appears in the queue, treat the request as standard unless the file says otherwise, and keep Zoe's movement notes separate from general baggage remarks. The desk has had a steady flow this evening, and the next crew should find the paperwork clear, the lounge orderly, and the service path easy to follow.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
